palette: dark bronze-green clock hall + patina green marks + water blue gauges + ivory float arrows + vermilion red lines + ink black
typography: water-clock works headlines, gauge labels, square patina-jade verdict stamps, dashed graduation rules
composition: a graduation desk with two subscription axes and a five-year drip, an uneven-cut scale tilting the founding ratio, and a paper-cut dial that only moves the hand without releasing water
surface: bronze clock walls with water gauges and ivory arrows; no glossy panels
motion: water rises and is cut in legal order, the vote dial fills to consensus shortfall, paper-cut stamps land on procedure items; no idle loops
transition: the clock works persist while each scene re-stages the same gauge wall for a new question
